metadata.description: Deterministic three-system birth-chart Skill: Western natal, BaZi (四柱八字) and Zi Wei Dou Shu (紫微斗数).

plugins.name: calculate-birth-charts
plugins.description: Calculate Western natal charts, BaZi and Zi Wei Dou Shu offline and deterministically, then on request narrate a sourced reading (吉凶/喜用神/大运流年) and 1-5 person 合婚/relationship synastry. The bundled CLI does all math — the model never computes charts.
